title: GTA6 Looming: Phantom Blade Zero Voted October Game of the Month
description: As the gaming world prepares for GTA6, October delivered a massive lineup of PS5 releases. Push Square readers vote Phantom Blade Zero as Game of the Month.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Calm Before the GTA6 Storm: October's Big Winner

As the entire industry counts down the days toward the monumental launch of GTA6, the months leading up to it continue to deliver an unprecedented wave of gaming entertainment. According to the latest reader poll conducted by gaming outlet Push Square, *Phantom Blade Zero* has officially claimed the title of Game of the Month for October 2026.

### A Frenetic 31 Days on PS5

October is frequently referred to by the community as "the month before GTA 6." Following hot on the heels of an equally manic September, the past 31 days proved to be an incredibly busy period for new PS5 releases. The sheer volume of games hitting the market made this latest Game of the Month poll one of the most intriguing and hotly contested in recent memory.

In a gaming landscape where the upcoming release of GTA6 casts a massive shadow over every single announcement, players are actively seeking out standout experiences to fill their libraries. The intense competition on the PlayStation 5 platform throughout October demonstrated that players are still fiercely engaged with diverse, high-caliber titles.

### Standing Out in a Crowded Field

Push Square's monthly polls serve as an essential barometer for core player sentiment. For *Phantom Blade Zero* to capture the top spot among a packed lineup of heavy-hitting releases highlights its strong appeal and the incredible momentum it has built up within the community.

While analysis suggests that players are eagerly anticipating the industry-shaping arrival of GTA6, October proved that the appetite for top-tier action games remains insatiable. The victory for *Phantom Blade Zero* reflects a community eager to celebrate exceptional craftsmanship right up until the next era of gaming begins.

## Editor's Take

With GTA6 looming on the horizon, October's crowded release schedule could easily have overshadowed smaller or mid-tier releases. However, *Phantom Blade Zero* rising to the top through community votes proves that stellar gameplay and high production values will always find an audience, even in the shadow of history-making blockbusters.
